questions.question: According to Paul, what must a person do to be saved?
options: Confess Jesus as Lord and believe God raised him from the dead
Offer sacrifices and keep the appointed feasts faithfully
Be circumcised and keep the whole law of Moses
Be baptized in water and receive the laying on of hands
questions.answer: Confess Jesus as Lord and believe God raised him from the dead
